description: This file contains formatters and class definitions related to the PUSCH (Physical Uplink Shared Channel) processing in a 5G NR (New Radio) implementation, including custom formatters for various PUSCH-related data structures and a helper class for handling bad payloads.

classes.name: uci_bad_payload
classes.description: Helper class to generate a bad payload span of bytes for invalid UCI payloads.

methods.name: uci_bad_payload::get
methods.description: Returns the bad payload as a span of bytes.

methods.name: formatter<ocudu::pusch_processor::codeword_description>::parse
methods.description: Parses formatting options for codeword description.

methods.name: formatter<ocudu::pusch_processor::codeword_description>::format
methods.description: Formats the codeword description with optional verbose fields.

methods.name: formatter<ocudu::pusch_processor::uci_description>::parse
methods.description: Parses formatting options for UCI description.

methods.name: formatter<ocudu::pusch_processor::uci_description>::format
methods.description: Formats UCI description including ACK, CSI parts, and scaling parameters.

methods.name: formatter<ocudu::pusch_processor::pdu_t>::format
methods.description: Formats PDU details including context, BWP, symbols, UCI, modulation, codeword, and DMRS info.

methods.name: formatter<ocudu::pusch_decoder_result>::parse
methods.description: Parses formatting options for decoder result.

methods.name: formatter<ocudu::pusch_decoder_result>::format
methods.description: Formats decoder result including CRC status and iteration stats.

methods.name: formatter<ocudu::pusch_processor_result_data>::parse
methods.description: Parses formatting options for result data.

methods.name: formatter<ocudu::pusch_processor_result_control>::parse
methods.description: Parses formatting options for control result.

methods.name: formatter<ocudu::pusch_processor_result_control>::format
methods.description: Formats control result including HARQ ACK and CSI payloads, with handling for invalid payloads.
